description: The source explicitly supplies metadata and experimental data for the pilot-scale capacitive-electrodialysis study, with a DOCX descriptor. A second deposit supplies water-quality and energy-efficiency details for ULTIMATE Case Study 2. Both are grouped as related study components, without assuming identical or independent observations. The associated pilot used 19.32 square metres of membrane area and a stated capacity of 1–4 cubic metres per day. Described experiments vary voltage, cross-flow velocity, staging, water recovery and feed composition. The source reports ion removal and nutrient concentration; exact table layout and observation dates remain unknown. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
